item.title: Test your global economic knowledge with this quick Planet Money quiz!
item.description: Every country tells a different economic story. It's time to test your knowledge of the big ideas we've collected on our World Tour. Eight questions stand between you and your Summer School diploma.

item.title: More than 50 kidnapped as violent gang attack in Haiti leaves 47 dead
item.description: It is believed to be one of the largest mass kidnappings in Haiti in recent years, and one gang leader is threatening to kill the hostages if authorities kill any gang members as they try to secure the community nestled in the hills above Port-au-Prince.
